blocks.title: Source evaluation
blocks.text: Source evaluation ka matlab jaanchna hai ke maloomat kahan se aayi.
Sarkari websites aur maaruf khabron ke idare aam taur par motabar hain kyunke durustagi ke sakht usool mante hain; Pakistani sarkari websites misal hain.

blocks.prompt: Exam ki tareekhon ke liye kya zyada motabar hai: board ki official website ya aage bheja gaya social media paigham?
blocks.explanation: Board ki official website, kyunke yeh asal aur jawabdeh maakhaz hai.

items: Source evaluation: kis ne shaya kiya? Official aur maaruf maakhaz zyada motabar.
